meta.title: OnlyPants — Curated Thrift Pants & Streetwear
meta.description: Online thrift store for vintage pants, streetwear, and OnlyPants merch. Every piece is hand-picked, with measurements and condition notes.

home.heroSubtitle: Every piece is hand-picked, condition-checked, and one of a kind. If you like it, don't wait too long.
home.why1Body: No bulk bales. We pick, wash, and photograph every piece ourselves.
home.why2Body: Detailed measurements and a condition score. Flaws? We list them.
home.why3Body: Scan with any e-wallet or mobile banking app.
home.aboutBody: OnlyPants is an online thrift shop for streetwear and vintage. We focus on pants with character: cargos, carpenters, artwork denim, and hard-to-find pieces, plus our own OnlyPants merch.
home.waBody: Chat with us on WhatsApp, we usually reply fast during opening hours.
